context: Officer Takeda is doing morning school safety patrol. He and Ms. Asuka exchange small notes about the children.
purpose: civic professional cooperation — police and teacher protecting children together

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: おはようございます。今朝も、見守りで。
lines.en: Good morning. This morning too, here to watch over.
lines.style: Officer warm professional polite morning, the soft real real-civic warmth audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いつもありがとうございます。助かります。
lines.en: Thank you always. It saves us.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal sincere professional gratitude, the soft real real-respect audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 昨日、通学路で子供たちが少しふざけてて。
lines.en: Yesterday, on the way to school, the kids were horsing around a bit.
lines.style: Officer warm professional careful reporting, the soft real real-careful audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あら、注意しておきます。教えていただいて。
lines.en: Oh, I'll caution them. Thank you for telling me.
lines.style: Teacher warm professional concerned thanking, the soft real real-attentive audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 事故にならないように、お互い見ていきましょう。
lines.en: So no accidents — let's watch together.
lines.style: Officer warm professional collaborative wisdom, the soft real real-partnership audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本当にそうですね。協力して、お願いします。
lines.style: Teacher warm professional sincere committed, the soft real real-respect audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 何かあれば、いつでもご連絡ください。
lines.en: If anything happens, contact me anytime.
lines.style: Officer warm professional generous extending, the soft real real-civic care audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 心強いです。今日もよろしくお願いします。
lines.style: Teacher warm professional warm sincere closing, the soft real real-respect audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.
